name: Disable Data Collection Hosts
description: Stops Windows from collecting hosts data
commands:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v DisableEnterpriseHosts /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
 
 reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
